name: CI/CD

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --workspace --all-targets --verbose

      - name: Run linter
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --workspace --all-targets --verbose

      - name: Security audit
        run: cargo audit

  release:
    needs: ci
    if: github.ref_type == 'tags'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CARGO_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}/.cargo
      RUSTUP_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}/.rustup
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --workspace --all-targets --verbose

      - name: Create release artifacts
        run: |
          mkdir -p releases
          for target in x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu x86_64-unknown-linux-musl aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu x86_64-apple-darwin aarch64-apple-darwin x86_64-pc-windows-msvc; do
            cargo build --target $target --release
            case $target in
              *linux*) ext=tar.gz ;;
              *darwin*) ext=tar.gz ;;
              *windows*) ext=zip ;;
            esac
            tar -czf releases/keifu-$target.$ext target/$target/release/keifu
          done

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: releases/keifu-*.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-*.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Generate changelog
        id: generate_changelog
        uses: git-changelog-action/action@v2
        with:
          title: Changelog
          labels: "changelog"

      - name: Publish release
        id: publish_release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          body: ${{ steps.generate_changelog.outputs.changelog }}

      - name: Configure Trusted Publishing
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=trusted_publishing::true"
        id: trusted_publishing

      - name: Set up crates.io credentials
        run: echo "$CRATES_IO_API_KEY" | docker login --username=__token__ --password-stdin https://crates.io

      - name: Publish to crates.io
        run: cargo publish --manifest-path crate/Cargo.toml

        uses: actions/checkout@v2

          override: true

              *darwin*) ext=tar.gz ;;
              *windows*) ext=zip ;;
            esac
            tar -czf releases/keifu-$target.$ext target/$target/release/keifu

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1

        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: releases/keifu-*.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-*.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Generate changelog
        id: generate_changelog
        uses: git-changelog-action/action@v2
        with:

          labels: "changelog"

          body: ${{ steps.generate_changelog.outputs.changelog }}
